sn32.2:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn32.2:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.2:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn32.2:1.4: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati, vācāya sucaritaṃ carati, manasā sucaritaṃ carati.
sn32.2:1.8: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn32.2:1.9: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
sn32.2:1.10: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā valāhakakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
